title: Sphere rigidity
long_title: Rigidity of unit spheres in finite-dimensional real normed spaces
short_description: A study of how the metric structure of a unit sphere determines its ambient real normed space, with a separate route toward reusable proof tools.
summary: A brief report presenting the mathematical statements and proofs is ready for private preview. The report is a standalone record; conventional-paper preparation, formalization, and reusable-library work continue independently.

claim.label: CLAIM PRESENTED IN THE BRIEF REPORT
claim.text: Finite-dimensional real normed spaces with isometric unit spheres are linearly isometric as normed spaces.
claim.qualifier: This is an existence statement about the two spaces. It is not a claim that a prescribed sphere isometry extends to a linear isometry.
claim.preview_note: This is a preliminary, AI-assisted manuscript. Full human verification of this report version has not been completed.
